date_note: Task/as-of date; environment wall-clock date may differ. No future publication inference is intended.
scope: Bounded targeted primary-source audit, not an exhaustive or systematic review. Twenty selected sources include supporting ontologies, libraries and languages as separately typed comparators.

baseline_evidence.interpretation: structured_non_rdf is a register label, not proof of corpus parsing or execution
baseline_evidence.mapping_count_note: Baseline a5f90557 had 12 accepted alignment rows (schema_org 5, prov_o 5, ssn_sosa 2, owl_time 0). Concurrent corrections may change these; no final mapping count asserted by this historical register.

status_definitions.missing: Absent from the two inspected source inventories before this audit; not a global absence claim.
status_definitions.metadata_only: Registered or textually charted; external formal artefact not parsed into a local term inventory.
status_definitions.parsed: Existing local RDF has parse/provenance evidence.
status_definitions.mapped: Accepted alignment rows exist; semantic review quality must be checked separately.
status_definitions.executed: Concrete source-specific adapter/runtime executed with recorded evidence; none newly executed in this audit.

search_protocol.strategy: Targeted keyword searches, GTO backward-reference check, direct official documentation/repository opens; system1 used to verify primary coverage gaps. Secondary hits used only as discovery leads.

queries.query: game theory ontology Mejbri 2013 2018 ontology game theory
video game ontology VGO GBO game ontology primary
"A Domain Ontology of Game Theory Applied to Game Based Learning" Mejbri pdf
GDL II Thielscher 2010 general game playing imperfect information paper

search_protocol.direct_open_policy: Primary project pages, original publisher/author papers and source repositories only for substantive conclusions. Retrieval failures retained explicitly.
search_protocol.exclusions: Unrelated blockchain/GeoLink GBO acronyms, unrelated OpenGameEngine videogame engine, philosophical ontology discussions without operational strategic vocabulary, search spam.
search_protocol.stopping_rule: Stop after required ontology/library/language/runtime/environment families receive a primary-source disposition; no saturation or exhaustive coverage claim.

sources.name: Mejbri Game Theory Ontology: 2013 predecessor documented in 2018 paper

licence.name: CC-BY-3.0
licence.scope: 2018 paper; standalone ontology artefact licence unverified

sources.disposition: Priority predecessor: chart published concepts; locate original 2013 paper and WSML/OWL artefact before term-level equivalence claims.
sources.bibliographic_note: The 2018 article is Towards a new requirements’ definition methodology using ontologies for Pervasive Games Based Learning Systems, by Yemna Mejbri, Maha Khemaja and Kaouther Raies. Reference 40 cites the 2013 A Domain Ontology of Game Theory Applied to Game Based Learning. Do not treat these as two independently acquired ontology releases.
limitations: 2013 full paper and standalone ontology not acquired
2018 narrative confirmation does not establish complete term coverage

sources.name: Game Ontology Project (GOP)
sources.disposition: Adjacent game-design vocabulary; compare structural elements without counting it as a complete strategic-game ontology.

sources.name: Core Game Ontology (CGO)

sources.name: Stanford Game Description Language
sources.disposition: Replace secondary discovery URL in future appended evidence with primary Stanford reference; chart roles/legal actions/state/goal/terminal.

sources.name: GDL-II: incomplete-information game description
sources.disposition: Separate GDL-II from combined variant seed; chart randomness and incomplete state knowledge. This row does not verify GDL-III/GDLZ.

sources.name: Ludii general game system
sources.disposition: Use ludemes and sampled game descriptions as construct evidence; no executable or corpus acquisition claimed.

sources.name: OpenSpiel

sources.name: PyCID causal influence diagrams
sources.disposition: Chart causal vs informational links, decisions, utility ownership and intervention semantics; avoid treating a causal graph as an extensive-form tree.

sources.name: CyberCat Open Game Engine
sources.disposition: Chart composition, context and profitable-deviation diagnostics; distinct from unrelated OpenGameEngine 2D/3D engine.
